metadata.case_name: HO KIN LON v. WONG TIN CHI AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: soft tissue injuries of the neck
source: The plaintiff sustained soft tissue injuries of the neck, right thigh and right knee. There were also abrasions to the right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: soft tissue injuries of the right thigh
source: The plaintiff sustained soft tissue injuries of the neck, right thigh and right knee. There were also abrasions to the right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at hip or thigh level

injuries.description: soft tissue injuries of the right knee
source: The plaintiff sustained soft tissue injuries of the neck, right thigh and right knee. There were also abrasions to the right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of other or unspecified parts of knee

source: Abrasions were noted over his right thigh and leg.
There were also abrasions to the right leg.

manifestations.description: tenderness was elicited over right cervical back
mild tenderness over left side paraspinal muscles of cervical spine
abrasions over his right thigh and leg
scars in the right lower limb were well healed
range of movement of the neck was satisfactorily preserved
no ligament or meniscal abnormality was noted in the right knee; the range of movement of the right knee was good

treatments_received.treatment: Accident and Emergency treatment at Kwong Wah Hospital by ambulance
source: Immediately after the accident on 7 January 2009, the plaintiff was sent to the Accident and Emergency Department of Kwong Wah Hospital (“KWH”) by ambulance for immediate treatment.
X-ray films of cervical spines were unremarkable.

treatments_received.treatment: Discharged same day with 3 days sick leave (7 January 2009 to 9 January 2009)
source: The plaintiff was treated and discharged on the same day with 3 days sick leave granted to him by KWH for the period from 7 January 2009 to 9 January 2009.

treatments_received.treatment: Outpatient treatment at UMP Medical Centre (Tung Chung) under Dr. Lawrence C.F. Wong on 9 January 2009 and 14 January 2009
source: The plaintiff attended UMP Medical Centre (Tung Chung) under the care of Dr. Lawrence C.F. Wong for further treatment on 9 January 2009 and 14 January 2009 respectively.

treatments_received.treatment: 5 days sick leave (10 January 2009 to 12 January 2009 and 15 January 2009 to 16 January 2009)
source: 5 days sick leaves were granted to the plaintiff for the period from 10 January 2009 to 12 January 2009 and from 15 January 2009 to 16 January 2009.

treatments_received.treatment: Attendance at Tung Chung General Outpatient Clinic several times since 12 January 2009
source: Since 12 January 2009, the plaintiff had attended Tung Chung General Outpatient Clinic several times for further treatment because of residual right leg pain and neck pain.

treatments_received.treatment: Referral to physiotherapy department at Princess Margaret Hospital
source: The plaintiff was then referred to the physiotherapy department at Princess Margaret Hospital for treatment due to residual neck pain.

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy (2 sessions) at Princess Margaret Hospital
source: The plaintiff received 2 sessions of physiotherapy treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital.
As a result of the accident, the plaintiff had been given in total 15 days sick leaves.
Medical expenses $350.00
Travelling expense $300.00
Nourishing food $2,000.00

treatments_received.treatment: Repairing costs for MH1531 $8,877.00 (special damages claim allowed)
source: Repairing costs for MH1531 $8,877.00
Survey report fee $800.00
Towing fee $550.00
Parking fee ($310/31 x 24 days) $240.00

treatments_received.treatment: Damaged mobile phone $3,280.00 (special damages claim allowed)
source: Damaged mobile phone $3,280.00

treatments_received.treatment: Helmet, gloves and jacket $3,005.00 (special damages claim allowed)
source: Helmet, gloves and jacket $3,005.00

losses.description: Work efficiency would be affected by mild residual pain and stiffness over his neck, affecting concentration and ability to work for extended periods.
Work efficiency would be affected by mild residual pain and stiffness over his right leg and he might experience difficulties when lifting heavy objects.
